basic_profile.bio: I'm a longtime Redditor based in Charlotte, NC. By day, I'm a research assistant in a local university's biochemistry department. I spend my free time preparing for the MCAT, experimenting with salsa recipes, and keeping up with the latest technology trends. I’m a huge fan of Odd Future and enjoy discussing their music with other fans. Most of my Reddit activity happens in the evenings, especially after 8 PM, as that's when I unwind from work. Currently in a relationship and enjoy spending weekends exploring new places or trying out new tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Biochemistry and a minor in Psychology, I have a strong foundation in the sciences. My interest in technology has led me to self-teach programming and keep up with the latest advancements in hardware. My MCAT preparation has further deepened my understanding of complex biological and chemical concepts.
